upgrade.tooltip.body.one: Raises a ship with {count} Hull Upgrade point to {points}. Apply it on the Hull Upgrades panel in the refit screen. It is used up.
upgrade.tooltip.body.other: Raises a ship with {count} Hull Upgrade points to {points}. Apply it on the Hull Upgrades panel in the refit screen. It is used up.
upgrade.tooltip.disabled: Hull Upgrades are switched off in LunaLib settings. Switch them back on to apply this.
upgrade.tooltip.chartMode: Star Chart Progress is on in LunaLib settings, so this can't be applied.
upgrade.tooltip.storage: Opening Hull Item Storage or the Hull Upgrades panel moves this from your cargo into storage.
framework.panel.title: Hull Upgrades
framework.confirm.title: Apply a {name}?
framework.confirm.body: It will be used up, leaving {left} in storage, and this ship will have {points} of {max} Hull Upgrade points.
framework.panel.hint: Refit Schematics raise a ship one point at a time, from Scrapped to Domain, up to {max}. Spend points to unlock sections. Locking a section again returns its point.
framework.panel.hintCharts: Clearing Star Charts raises every ship's points, up to {max}. Spend points to unlock sections. Locking a section again returns its point.
framework.panel.upgradeReady: Click to apply. It is used up and raises this ship to {points} points.
framework.panel.upgradeAtMax: This ship already has the maximum of {max} points.
framework.panel.upgradeNone: You have none. Refit Schematics drop from salvage, Tech Mining and battles once you reach level {level}.
framework.panel.chartsNext: Clear a tier {tier} Star Chart to raise every ship to {points} points.
framework.panel.chartsMax: Every ship has the maximum of {max} points from Star Charts.
framework.panel.chartsOff: Star Chart Progress needs Star Charts, which are switched off, so every ship has 1 point.
points.chartRaised: Star Chart cleared: every ship now has {points} Hull Upgrade points.
framework.socketHint.unlocked: Click to lock this section again. Its point is returned and any hull item in it goes back to storage.
framework.socketHint.available: Click to spend a Hull Upgrade point on this section.
framework.socketHint.restricted: This ship cannot use this section with its current fit.
framework.socketHint.noPoints: Apply a Refit Schematic to gain a point for this section.
framework.socketHint.noPointsCharts: Clear a higher tier Star Chart to gain a point for this section.
framework.socketDescription.bridge: Holds bridge officers who improve combat readiness, weapon handling and how hard the ship hits each hull size.
framework.socketDescription.crew_quarter: Holds specialist crews for crew capacity, upkeep, repairs, sensors, electronic warfare and salvage.
framework.socketDescription.engine_room: Holds drive assemblies for speed, maneuverability, burn level and fuel economy.
framework.socketDescription.reactor: Holds power regulators for venting, capacitors, EMP resistance and weapon flux costs.
framework.socketDescription.armor_platin: Holds bolt-on plating for armor, hull and damage resistance.
framework.socketDescription.weapon_mount: Holds fire control for weapon damage, range, ammunition and point defense.
framework.socketDescription.shield_gener: Holds shield emitters for shield efficiency, upkeep, arc and response.
framework.socketDescription.phase_coil: Holds phase coils for cloak cost, phase speed and stealth.
framework.socketDescription.flight_deck: Holds deck crews for strikecraft replacement, refit times and strikecraft performance.
framework.socket.removeHint: Right-click the section to return this hull item to storage, or click it to choose a different one.
ui.socketStorage.placingHintFramework: Click the highlighted {type} section on the ship to install {name}. Esc cancels.
ui.socketStorage.placingHintFrameworkLoc: This ship has no {type} section unlocked for {name}. Unlock it in Hull Upgrades first. Esc cancels.
settings.socketStorage.hullUpgrades.name: Enabled
settings.socketStorage.hullUpgrades.tool: When off, Refit Schematics and hull items other than Subroutines stop dropping, and unlocked sections stop working until it's switched back on.
settings.socketStorage.hullUpgradesLevel: Player level at which Refit Schematics and hull items start dropping.
settings.socketStorage.hullUpgradePoints: Refit Schematics add one point at a time, up to 5. Star Chart Progress raises every ship to 2, 3 and 4 points as you clear tier 5, 10 and 15 Star Charts, and needs Star Charts switched on.
settings.socketStorage.battleItems.name: Hull Item Drops From Battles
settings.socketStorage.battleItems.toolt: 100 is normal and 0 turns them off.
hullItem.doubler.line: Doubles the modifiers of this ship's {section} item.
